1| # driftwatch replay
2| 
3| Replay re-reads rolled spool segments and hands them to the exporter.
4| It exists for exporter outages and for backfills after a schema
5| change; it never touches the active segment, so ingest keeps running
6| while a replay is in flight.
7| 
8| ## Running a replay
9| 
10| Start the daemon with the replay subcommand and a segment range, or
11| omit the range to resume from the checkpoint. Progress is
12| checkpointed continuously, so an interrupted replay resumes where it
13| left off rather than re-reading from the start.
14| 
15| ## Drills
16| 
17| Run the monthly drill against staging with a bounded range first.
18| Watch the exporter lag panel during the drill; replay deliberately
19| yields to live ingest when the exporter falls behind, so a slow drill
20| is usually a sign of exporter pressure, not replay trouble.
